title: Leo: what I'm keeping
old_caption: You don't need applause to be worth loving, and you don't have to look fine all the time. Keep the big warm heart, and give it real rest between the bright moments.

title: Virgo: what I'm keeping
old_caption: Noticing the little things is a gift, until it turns into fixing people or replaying every word at night. Keep the noticing. Turn some of it toward yourself.

title: Libra: what I'm keeping
old_caption: Keeping the peace shouldn't cost you yourself. This year, when someone asks what you want, try answering. Your charm stays, and your wants get a seat at the table too.

title: Scorpio: what I'm keeping
old_caption: Loyalty doesn't need to be tested to be real. Let the walls come down a little, keep the all-in devotion, and say your trust out loud instead of hiding it.

title: Sagittarius: what I'm keeping
old_caption: A joke is a great way to start a hard conversation and a hard way to finish one. Keep the honesty, drop the maybe-plans, and say the real thing first.

title: Capricorn: what I'm keeping
old_caption: Feelings don't fit neatly on a schedule, and they don't need to. Keep the steady promises you're known for, and make room for dinner, and for the heart, without a deadline.

title: Aquarius: what I'm keeping
old_caption: Going quiet when someone gets close can look like not caring, even when you care a lot. Keep your wonderful ideas, and let the right people in a little closer this year.

title: Pisces: what I'm keeping
old_caption: Loving someone's potential is not the same as loving who they are right now. Keep your soft heart, stop apologising for your feelings, and carry them a little braver.

title: Space or talk it out?
old_caption:
One of you needs to talk right now. The other needs an hour.
Neither is wrong. Knowing it before the fight means nobody feels left or cornered. An hour apart, then together.

title: The comfort meal
old_caption:
Ask what their comfort meal is, and listen closely.
It tells you exactly what to bring on their worst day. Soup, cereal at midnight, whatever it is. Save this for a bad week.
